verdict.rationale: Auth0's Universal Login provides hosted, production-ready, branded login pages (auth0-docs-85, auth0-docs-49), and a community user praises its JavaScript-free implementation (auth0-comm-1). Forms adds a no-code visual editor for custom sign-up and login flows and their UI (auth0-docs-86, auth0-docs-53), so sign-in and sign-up via customizable hosted pages are clearly covered. Missing for 10: evidence of a prebuilt end-user profile management UI (only progressive profiling is mentioned, in auth0-docs-84), framework-embeddable sign-in/sign-up UI components, and independent hands-on corroboration of the customization depth.
